factors.production_system: country-average cotton cultivation and fiber production
factors.geography: GLO country averages represented by study data
factors.source_name: Textile Exchange Life Cycle Assessment for Cotton (2026)
factors.source_locator: printed p.250, Table G-14, GLO country averages, EF 3.1 Climate change total
limitations: Study data coverage is not equivalent to every cotton supply chain or Korean sourcing.

factors.review_note: Research/demo proxy only. Source table and source-use restrictions reviewed on 2026-10-01.
factors.selection_assumption: Use the report's GLO country-averages EF 3.1 climate-change total as a generic cotton research proxy when product-specific origin and production data are unavailable.

factors.production_system: published unweighted average of virgin staple fiber cases SF1, SF2 and SF3
factors.geography: study supplier cases; not a global production-weighted average
factors.source_name: Textile Exchange Life Cycle Assessment for Polyester (2026)
factors.source_locator: printed p.143, Table 67 published average; pp.147-148, Tables 71-73 EF 3.1 case totals
limitations: 4.55 is the report's published unweighted average of three virgin staple-fiber cases, not a global production-weighted polyester average.
The cases cover virgin staple fibers and do not represent filament, recycled polyester, or every polyester label.
One case is black fiber and two cases are white fiber; the mean is not production-volume weighted.
Textile Exchange states that the results are not intended for public or marketing claims, including on-product labels.
The study is not intended for comparisons between fibers or materials.

carbon_accounting.aggregation: report-published unweighted average based on underlying study results
carbon_accounting.displayed_case_values_note: The displayed case totals 4.74, 4.93 and 3.96 average to 4.5433; do not recalculate the report's published 4.55 from rounded display values.

factors.review_note: Research/demo proxy only. Derived mean and source-use restrictions reviewed on 2026-10-01.
factors.selection_assumption: Use only as an explicitly labeled virgin staple fiber research proxy when the label provides no polyester production-form detail; do not treat it as a universal polyester default.
